high.title: Selic Expected to Fall, But How Far Can COPOM Go? 17 Institutions Make Their Bets — See Projections
high.summary: Today marks a critical COPOM decision day, with Brazil's Monetary Policy Committee set to announce its new benchmark interest rate. Of 17 banks and brokerages surveyed by Money Times, 16 expect a 25 basis point cut, bringing the Selic from 14.25% to 14.00% per annum — signaling broad market consensus around continued monetary easing. The sole outlier is Citi, which projects the rate will be held at 14.25%, arguing the Central Bank may opt for a more cautious stance.
